text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it, sold out on this site too, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Give up and buy a new model...? Nah, that 
still rubs me the wrong way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A new model having worse performance? 
That's total bullshit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Guess I've got no choice but to hit the 
stores myself. ...What a pain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With his favorite headphones broken, Air 
Shakur was forced to scour everywhere for 
the exact same model.
